problem_statement: datastax/ragbot-starter (rebranded here as RAGBot, a Next.js 14 + React chat assistant for Astra DB / vector search) hosts its own Prompt library on the chat surface: a category-filter prompt browser (components/PromptLibrary/PromptLibrary.tsx) with an eyebrow 'Prompt library', a title, a category tab bar (All prompts / Vector Search / Astra DB / CassIO / FAQ), a live '#plib-readout' that reads 'Showing N of 12 · <Category>', and a grid of twelve starter-prompt cards, each with its category chip, prompt text and a one-line blurb. The same Prompt library is meant to appear on the chat home, the dedicated /library page and the /help page (registered through the shared components/PromptLibrary/surfaces.ts whitelist), and clicking a category tab must filter the visible cards and update the readout live. Three things are broken: (1) on a 390px phone the tab bar and card grid sit in fixed-width no-wrap flex tracks wider than the screen, so the whole chat shell scrolls horizontally (app/prompt-library.css); (2) the Prompt library was only wired into the chat home, so the /library and /help routes render no prompt browser; and (3) the category tabs must actually re-filter the cards and recompute the count, not just move the active-tab styling. Fix app/prompt-library.css so the tab bar and card grid wrap and no longer overflow at 390px while staying legible; register the Prompt library on the /library and /help routes as well as the chat home via components/PromptLibrary/surfaces.ts; and wire components/PromptLibrary/PromptLibrary.tsx so clicking a category filters the cards and updates the readout live. Keep the chat shell (header, message surface, Configure panel, send box, theme toggle) and every prompt, label and category intact.
required_content: Render the Prompt library (class 'plib') on the chat home, the /library page AND the /help page: an eyebrow 'Prompt library', a title 'Browse starter prompts by topic', a category tab bar (class plib__tabs) with the buttons All prompts / Vector Search / Astra DB / CassIO / FAQ (class plib__tab), a readout (class plib__readout) that starts at 'Showing 12 of 12 · All prompts', and a grid (class plib__grid) of twelve prompt cards (class plib__card), each with a category chip, the prompt text and a blurb.

Fix app/prompt-library.css so the tab bar and card grid do not cause horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width (documentElement / content right-edge within the viewport, tolerance 24px); the tabs and cards must wrap / flex down rather than sit in a fixed no-wrap row.
Register the Prompt library on the /library and /help routes as well as the chat home (components/PromptLibrary/surfaces.ts) so the same prompt browser renders cross-page.

Wire the category tabs (components/PromptLibrary/PromptLibrary.tsx) so clicking a category filters the visible prompt cards to that category and updates the readout live to 'Showing 3 of 12 · Vector Search' (and back to 'Showing 12 of 12 · All prompts' for All prompts); the readout and the visible cards must reflect the tab that was actually clicked, not a stale captured value.
Keep the prompt cards legible (readable category chip / prompt text / blurb on the card surface) and non-overlapping; the fix is layout + wiring, not clipping or dropping content.
Keep the surrounding chat shell intact: the RAGBot header, the message surface, the Configure panel, the send box, the theme toggle, and the shared site nav.
design_constraints: The layout fix is in app/prompt-library.css; do not clip the overflow (overflow-x:hidden on a still-too-wide no-wrap track leaves the document overflowing) — let the tabs and cards wrap / flex so the content fits a 390px phone.

Preserve the Prompt library's visual system (rounded pill tabs, card borders, purple accent chips, soft card surface) on desktop and tablet; the cards must stay legible and must not collapse into an unreadable near-white-on-near-white or overlapping pile.
The Prompt library must appear on the chat home, /library and /help with the same markup; a library that only renders on the chat home breaks the cross-page invariant.

The category tabs must re-read the clicked category on each click and re-filter the cards and recompute the count; a handler that only moves the active-tab class but leaves the readout and cards stale is not acceptable.
Do not break the Next build configuration, the prompt dataset (data/prompt-library.ts), or the chat shell components.
Desktop (1440px), tablet (834px) and 390px mobile states must have no horizontal overflow and no console/network errors.

change_completion: The Prompt library renders on the chat home, /library and /help with the eyebrow, title, category tab bar, readout, and the twelve prompt cards.
Clicking a category tab filters the visible cards and updates the readout live to the clicked category and its count.
design_consistency: The Prompt library keeps its pill-tab / card visual system and purple accents on desktop and tablet, with legible non-overlapping prompt cards.
The chat shell (header, message surface, Configure panel, send box) remains intact.
regression: The chat home keeps its header, message surface, Configure panel, send box, theme toggle, and shared nav.
The Next build configuration, the prompt dataset, and the existing chat components are not broken.
responsive: The chat home has no horizontal overflow on desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile.
The Prompt library tab bar and card grid wrap and stay legible at 390px mobile.

state_constraints: desktop_home loads the chat home at 1440px: the Prompt library renders its tab bar, readout and twelve prompt cards with no horizontal overflow and legible cards.
mobile_home checks the chat home at 390px and MUST have no horizontal overflow (the repaired behaviour; the buggy baseline overflows here).
tablet_home checks the chat home at 834px with no horizontal overflow.
desktop_library loads the /library route and verifies the SAME Prompt library renders there (cross-page invariant).
desktop_help loads the /help route and verifies the SAME Prompt library renders there.
desktop_home_vector clicks the 'Vector Search' category tab on the chat home and verifies the readout updates to 'Showing 3 of 12 · Vector Search' and the cards filter.
scoring_notes: L4: the bad leg fails four orthogonal gates. D6 no_horizontal_overflow — the tab bar and card grid stay in fixed no-wrap tracks with overflow-x:hidden on the readout only, so the 390px phone still overflows. D3 visual_regression — the prompt cards collapse into an overlapping shingled pile (negative margins) with near-white-on-near-white text and near-white active tabs (contrast failure), so the whole Prompt library region is broken and unreadable on the desktop home. D2 dom_assertions — the Prompt library is only wired on the chat home, so /library and /help render no prompt browser. D4 interaction_assertions — clicking a category moves the active-tab class (the click succeeds) but the readout and cards are snapshotted at mount and never update. Baseline fails D6 + D3 + D2 (fixed no-wrap overflow + single-row desktop re-lay + library home-only) but PASSES D4 (its filter wiring is correct).

author_notes: Reassigned (dedup) + hardened-to-L4 task on the datastax/ragbot-starter RAGBot chat assistant (Next.js 14 + React, Astra DB / vector-search chatbot). The native lever is the app's OWN Prompt library — a category-filter prompt browser (pill tab bar + live 'Showing N of 12' count readout + a grid of twelve prompt cards with category chips, prompt text and blurbs) rendered on the chat home, the /library page and the /help page. Reference: the tab bar and card grid wrap fluidly (flex-wrap + grid auto-fill minmax + min-width:0) so 390px mobile overflow is 0, the Prompt library renders on all three routes, and the category tabs filter the cards and recompute the count live. Baseline: the buggy original keeps the fixed 720px/1980px no-wrap tab+card tracks (overflows mobile and re-lays the desktop grid into one spilling row) and only wires the library on the chat home, but its filter wiring is correct. Known-bad: the cards collapse into an overlapping illegible near-white-on-near-white pile (visual break), the library is home-only, and the tabs snapshot the cards/readout at mount so the count freezes on click. The lever spans three leg-varying files — app/prompt-library.css (D6+D3), components/PromptLibrary/PromptLibrary.tsx (D4), components/PromptLibrary/surfaces.ts (D2) — and the bad leg fails four orthogonal gates. The 12 prompt cards use local text chips and the dataset ships in data/prompt-library.ts; no remote/image asset is added; the RAGBot chat shell, Configure panel and send box are preserved. Mobile responsive design keeps the layout legible on a 390px phone.
